Speech to text, text to speech and text analysis.

## API key

- **Get your key here:** [console.deepgram.com](https://console.deepgram.com/)
- **Setting:** `DEEPGRAM_API_KEY`
- **API reference:** [developers.deepgram.com](https://developers.deepgram.com/reference/deepgram-api-overview)

### Get the key

1. Sign in to Deepgram and open [console.deepgram.com](https://console.deepgram.com/).
2. Create an API key (or token) with only the access your apps need.
3. Copy it. Many providers show a key only once.

**What to create:** An API key from the Deepgram Console; the Gateway sends it as Authorization: Token &lt;key>, and the EU, Australia and India hosts take the same key. Transcription (/v1/listen), speech (/v1/speak) and text analysis (/v1/read) are POSTs.

Steps for this provider are brief. [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Deepgram) to request a full guide.

### Set it on your Gateway

From your EveryApp folder:

```bash
everyapp secret set DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
```

It asks for the value at a hidden prompt, and it's live at once, with no deploy. If an app you've installed needs it, `everyapp configure <app>` asks for it along with everything else the app needs.

### Use it in an app

List it in the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  deepgram: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

`access` is `"read"`. The app calls the provider's own URLs with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

### Check it worked

- `everyapp provider show deepgram` shows the key as set and which apps use it.
- `everyapp status` shows apps that were waiting for it as ready.
- To test the key itself, `GET https://api.deepgram.com/v1/models` with it should answer 200; the call is free.

### Cost and limits

- **Cost:** Nova-3 pre-recorded $0.0043 per audio minute (pay as you go); Aura-2 speech $0.030 per 1k characters; $200 free credit.
- **Rate limits:** Concurrency per project on pay as you go: 50 pre-recorded transcriptions, 15 text-to-speech requests.
